content:
# Documentary import settlements and delivery titles

Scope: `documentary_imports` equipment-import contracts. These are synthetic service terms. All money fields are integer minor units; USD 100 is 10,000 minor units. Each order is a separate obligation even when invoice numbers or seller names overlap. Signed commercial credits reduce the order face amount only for the matching order and invoice period. Void and draft credits have no effect. Signed payment directions apply to new transfers during their inclusive effective interval; draft directions do not replace signed ones. A drawing accepted before a direction change remains payable to its recorded beneficiary.

## Payment records

Historical `cash_posting` rows with status `POSTED` are actual supplier receipts. New payments are recorded in `service_bookings`: `direct_pay` and `settle_confirmed` receipts contain `paid_minor`; a paid bank-event receipt contains `actual_minor`. An unpaid confirmation has no cash effect. Separate installments sharing a bank reference are separate receipts. A `bank_notice` is correspondence, not money. A settled drawing is another description of its associated settlement; it must not be added a second time to the cash posting. The cash balance excludes historical debits already made. An accepted drawing is still outstanding until the bank reports an actual amount. It may be partially honored; its requested amount is not a guaranteed actual debit.

At the recorded confirmation event an accepted drawing debits its actual amount, posts one supplier cash receipt and becomes final. It honors the beneficiary fixed by the accepted drawing. The unhonored remainder is returned rather than kept as another future debit. If cash is insufficient, the final amount is reported as `CONFIRMED_UNPAID`; `settle_confirmed` retries that amount and creates the receipt once. A recall request does not itself stop an accepted drawing. The confirmation instead reports the recalled drawing's actual honored amount, which may still be positive. Possible ranges are recorded on the drawing; only the actual event establishes which amount occurred.

Direct supplier payments can execute for any positive available amount to a registered beneficiary. They neither cancel an accepted drawing nor adjust its amount. The bank execution controls do not reconcile commercial overpayment or select the customer's current payment direction. This service cannot recover a completed supplier receipt. The commercial deadlines govern actual receipts, not prepared or approved instructions.

## Original titles and physical delivery

An original title may cover several orders. The bank keeps it while any associated drawing remains accepted, recall-requested or confirmed-unpaid. Once every associated drawing is final, `lodge_originals` delivers the original set to the carrier. Customer copies are not originals. A lodged set permits delivery of every listed order without a new title fee.

The bank can instead issue a delivery guarantee for a specified covered order while its original title remains in bank custody. Issuance immediately charges the recorded fee and sets aside the recorded cash collateral. Guarantees are order-specific; one guarantee cannot deliver another order on the same title. The fee is not refundable. Collateral is returned once when the original set is lodged with the carrier, closing every guarantee issued against that set. A guarantee is not a supplier payment or a title transfer. Temporary security must be recovered by a customer-required return deadline where stated.

A cargo instruction moves the specified positive quantity to a registered depot, using either its lodged original title or an active guarantee for that order. Partial deliveries are allowed. Cargo movements cannot be recalled in this service. The carrier accepts registered depots; the support agent must identify the customer's agreed depot and actual delivery deadline from the order.

## Instructions

Unlock `propose_documentary_import` and supply `case_id`, `action` and `data`. Each instruction requires the owner's approval of its exact arguments.

| Action | Data fields | Local effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `direct_pay` | `order_id`, `beneficiary_id`, `amount_minor` | Debit cash and record one real supplier receipt |
| `recall_drawing` | `drawing_id` | Request recall of an accepted drawing; wait for its confirmation |
| `settle_confirmed` | `drawing_id` | Pay a reported unpaid drawing amount |
| `issue_guarantee` | `order_id` | Charge the guarantee fee and set aside its collateral |
| `lodge_originals` | `title_id` | Deliver an available original to the carrier and return matching guarantee collateral |
| `deliver` | `order_id`, `depot_id`, `quantity_units` | Physically deliver covered cargo to a registered depot |

Queries and failed instructions do not advance the clock. `wait_for_update` advances to the next bank event. Inclusive deadlines may fall before the next event. The service does not borrow from unrelated business accounts.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_documentary_import`

Prepare a supplier payment, drawing recall or settlement, delivery guarantee, original-title lodgement or actual cargo delivery.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
